resources.string: These are your own records, not a clinical assessment. Saving an entry does not change treatment, confirm recovery or schedule a reminder. Review reminders require separate confirmation. Sharing this journal with an Agent requires your confirmation for each request.
Journal archived, not a recovery conclusion
I need to review or discuss this change
Check the current visit record before saving. A proposed adjustment or maintenance transition is not a treatment change or an accepted maintenance plan.
I am ending this journal and its review reminder, not confirming recovery or stopping treatment or other reminders.
Enter a follow-up goal, an observation or a reason as appropriate, and choose a review decision when reviewing.
First record that this visit took place. A planned appointment is not a completed visit.
The visit record has changed. Review it before relying on an earlier follow-up decision.
No follow-up records. Missing records do not establish improvement.

Delete this journal and its history, and cancel its review reminder? The visit, original files, instructions and other reminders will remain. The review action stays in history but cannot deliver an alert.
